listings.description: Always-on project rules for strict TypeScript, explicit types at boundaries, and no casual any.

files.typescript-strict.md:
---
activation: always
description: Strict TypeScript defaults for agent edits
---

# TypeScript Strict

- Prefer `unknown` over `any` at API boundaries; narrow before use.
- Do not silence type errors with `@ts-ignore` / `@ts-expect-error` unless the user asks.
- Keep public function return types explicit when inference would hide a contract.
- Match existing module import style (ESM / path aliases) in this repo.

# Verbose Explanations

When explaining changes, include rationale, alternatives considered, and residual risks.
Keep code edits minimal; do not expand scope for narration alone.
